notes: Fiscal year ended September 26, 2026 (data.js fy 'Sep 2026'); this edition skips FY2025. Financial figures are from the FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0000320193-26-000026, filed November 3, 2026) and match the SEC XBRL facts; ownership is from the 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001308179-26-000008, filed January 8, 2026), the latest proxy, as of its January 2, 2026 Table Date. LEADER: Steve Jobs is deceased. The 2026 proxy's ownership table lists only Vanguard, BlackRock, the directors and the named executive officers; the words 'Jobs' and 'Powell' do not appear anywhere in the proxy, so no Jobs estate, family or trust holding is disclosed and family is null. Neither the proxy nor the FY2026 10-K says anything about Jobs (the 10-K's only 'Jobs' is the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act), so the leader has no source. HOLDERS: Vanguard's 9.63% rests on a Schedule 13G/A reporting holdings at June 30, 2025; BlackRock's 7.10% still rests on a Schedule 13G/A reporting holdings at December 31, 2023, so it is stale; both are applied by the proxy against the January 2, 2026 share count. Dividends include dividend equivalents paid on RSUs, as the cash-flow line says. Geography is the five reportable segments from the MD&A table (the same figures appear in the segment note).
